ideas.pitch: An AI-powered matching platform that groups nearby Pacific Northwest seniors into social community outings, pairing them with student and local volunteer drivers.
ideas.title: PacificHealth PeerConnector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a tangible community impact in the local Pacific Northwest region, mirroring the winning formula of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and aerial imagery monitoring tool to track environmental and industrial land compliance across Washington state jurisdictions.
ideas.title: Cascadia Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves complex geospatial data interpretation tasks, capturing judge attention through hard engineering and clear environmental benefit akin to the Xcelerate Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning for local fintech compliance.
ideas.title: PugetSound AML Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans on heavy data pipelines and explainable AI models, following the exact blueprint that secured 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered no-code crypto trading bot platform tailored for students to build, copy, and execute automated strategies on decentralized perpetual markets.
ideas.title: Pacifica Campus Trader
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a fully functional product with immediate utility for crypto-native students, matching the execution style of the Pacifica Hackathon grand prize winner.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform that delivers personalized meal recommendations based on local Pacific Northwest grocery inventory and dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: NutriSeattle Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on personal wellness and practical daily utility, replicating the winning formula of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon.
